Small marginal notes stand in the right margin, mostly cut off at the page edge, and faint marks stand in the left margin. main_text.p: que Lycurgi, quas abrogaverat Philo-poemenes, Lacedæmoniis tum reddide-rit,aut in eam rem ftudium impenderit, & fundamenta ejus jecerit,apud me du-bium non eft. Nam acta Philopœmenis & Lycortæ, & qui earū partium erant, refcindere avebat, & abrogationem il-lam difplicuiffeRomanis,eofdemq; ean-dem Achæis exprobraffe non ignorabat. Omnia autem ftudia fua iftuc referebat, ut Romanis placeret, & grata faceret, quibus fe totum mancipaverat. In u-sum quidem rediffe apud Lacedæmo-nios Lycurgi inftituta pleraque, ad di-fciplinam præfertim pertinentia, abun-dè docent ea, quæ ante in defcriptione reipublicæ Laconicæ ex Cicerone, Stra-bone, Paufaniâ recitavimus. Hic Pau-fanias in Achaicis affirmat, non peron[illegible, ~3 letters] Callicratem Achæorum prætorem,ou quod ait Polybius autor multo certior, fed per legatos Romanos in Græciam rurfum miffos, principe legationis eo-dem Appio Claudio, exules Spartanos in patriam effe reductos. In quo nisi error Paufaniæ fit, verofimile fuerit, legatos eos Callicrati, ut facilius res conficeretur, fuiffe adjunctos. Et adjicit[illegible, ~3 letters] Paufanias, alia quoque à legatis iisdem[illegible] ad Spartanos pertinentia effe acta: ab[illegible] folutos nimirum criminis, & mulctæexem[illegible, ~4 letters]

page.notes: The right-hand margin notes are cut off by the page edge and are largely illegible; only fragments are visible, so their placement is approximate. Faint marks in the left margin, and small glyph clusters at the lower right of the text block, look like show-through or bleed from the reverse side and were not transcribed. The catchword "exem" is only partly legible. The word "difplicuiffeRomanis" is printed without a space and is copied as it appears on the scan. The line "Lycortæ" and "abrogaverat" are clear.
